title: 第19章 时光荏苒第20章 老王离去
slug: 南疆炼蛊三十载世人敬我如敬神
content_zh:
敖双可是四转玄蛊师，抓一个王昭昭该是手到擒来。
结果就这么死了？
除了是佘无立布置后手，皇甫南想不到第二种结果。
总不能是被残蛊楼的一个老头和两个小年轻杀死的吧？
“我必须尽快解毒才行！”
皇甫南心中升起了强烈的危机感。
佘无立若是恢复，第一件事就是来找他报仇，到时候死的就是他了。
……
时光飞逝。
转眼间，又是三月过去。
李元彻底放下心来。
看来皇甫南伤得很重，忌惮佘无立，不敢再踏足这里。
这给了他足够的发育时间。
“只要踏入四转蛊师境，我就无惧了。”
据他所知，皇甫南和佘无立都是五转蛊师，只要他成为四转蛊师，就足以自保。
“很快了。”
虚拟面板浮现。
【蛊师：李元】
【黑罐（三转291300）】
【境界：三转】

【本命蛊：气血蛊，回生蛊，三彩异火蟒】
“我加入十二洞，已经快一年半了吧？”
时间真的过得很快。
整日与蛊为伴，他都快忘记外面的世界是什么样子了。
“元哥哥！
元哥哥！
！”
忽然，王昭昭跌跌撞撞跑了过来，声音带着哭腔。
“怎么了？”
李元疑问。
“爷爷…爷爷他快不行了，你快去看看他。”
王昭昭抽泣着，泪眼婆娑。
“唉。”
李元立即起身，奔向寝房。
他加入残蛊楼时，老王年纪就不小了，又常年被残蛊楼煞气侵蚀，身体状况本就不好。
再加上在执法堂被逼供，以及三月前中了敖双那一拳，身体状态更是急转直下。
半个月前，老王就已卧病在床，一日不如一日。
李元早就想过这一天的到来。
来到房中。
content_en:
Ao Shuang is a level 4 Xuan Gu master, so catching Wang Zhaozhao should be easy.
So he died like that?
Apart from She Wuli's backup plan, Huangfunan couldn't think of the second outcome.
He couldn't have been killed by an old man and two young men from Can Gu Tower, right?
"I have to detoxify as soon as possible!"
A strong sense of crisis arose in Huangfunan's heart.
If She Wuli recovers, the first thing he will do is come to him for revenge, and he will be the one who dies.
…
Time flies.
In the blink of an eye, March has passed again.
Li Yuan was completely relieved.
It seems that Huangfu Nan was seriously injured and was afraid of She Wuli and did not dare to set foot here again.
This gives him enough time to develop.
"As long as I step into the rank four Gu Master realm, I will have nothing to fear."
As far as he knew, Huangfunan and She Wuli were both Rank 5 Gu Masters. As long as he became a Rank 4 Gu Master, he would be able to protect himself.
"Soon."
The virtual panel appears.
[Gu Master: Li Yuan]
[Black Can (Three Turns 291300)]
[Realm: Three Transformations]
[Original Gu: Qi and Blood Gu, Resurrection Gu, Three-color Strange Fire Python]
"It's been almost a year and a half since I joined Twelve Holes, right?"
Time flies really fast.
Being with Gu all day long, he almost forgot what the outside world was like.
"Brother Yuan!
Brother Yuan!
! "
Suddenly, Wang Zhaozhao stumbled over, his voice filled with tears.
"What's wrong?"
Li Yuan asked.
"Grandpa...Grandpa, he is dying. Go and see him quickly."
Wang Zhaozhao sobbed, with tears in his eyes.
"Alas."
Li Yuan immediately stood up and ran to the bedroom.
When he joined the Can Gu Tower, Lao Wang was already quite young, and he had been corroded by the evil spirit of the Can Gu Tower for many years, so his physical condition was not good.
Coupled with the fact that he was forced to confess in the law enforcement hall and the punch Ao Shuang received three months ago, his physical condition deteriorated even more.
Half a month ago, Lao Wang was bedridden and was getting worse every day.
Li Yuan had long thought about this day coming.
Come to the room.
